backend/main.mo: Motoko actor defining a Poem type and managing a Map of poems with functions to submit new poems, retrieve all poems sorted by title, and get a poem by ID.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting four implemented features: home page with poem grid, poem detail page, admin form for adding poems, and literary-inspired visual theme.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON object containing one-sentence summaries of all frontend source files including components, pages, hooks, and configuration files.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables defining a warm earth-tone color palette in OKLCH format for both light and dark modes.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with title 'Poetry Portal' and a root div that loads the React application via main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app component configuring TanStack Router with three routes (home, poem detail, admin) wrapped in Layout and QueryClientProvider.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Layout component providing sticky header with navigation, main content outlet, and footer with branding and caffeine.ai attribution link.
frontend/src/components/PoemCard.tsx: Clickable card component displaying poem preview with title, author, date, truncated content, and hover effects that navigates to poem detail page.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React Query hook that creates and manages the backend actor instance based on Internet Identity authentication state, invalidating dependent queries on identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: React context provider and hook for Internet Identity authentication, managing login state, identity persistence, and AuthClient lifecycle.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Custom React Query hooks for fetching all poems, fetching a poem by ID, and submitting new poems with automatic cache invalidation on success.
frontend/src/index.css: Global CSS file that imports Google Fonts (Crimson Text, Lora, Inter), configures Tailwind, and defines custom CSS variables for a warm earth-tone color scheme with light/dark mode support using OKLCH color space.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React root with QueryClient for data fetching and InternetIdentityProvider for authentication, then renders the App component.
frontend/src/pages/AdminForm.tsx: Admin form page component for adding new poems with fields for title, author, and content; includes form validation, loading states, and success feedback before redirecting to home.
frontend/src/pages/Home.tsx: Home page component that displays all poems in a responsive grid layout using PoemCard components, with loading and empty states.
frontend/src/pages/PoemDetail.tsx: Poem detail page component that displays a single poem's full content, title, author, and creation date with navigation back to the collection.
frontend/src/utils/formatDate.ts: Utility function that converts backend Time type (nanoseconds as BigInt) to a human-readable date string in 'Month Day, Year' format.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration that extends the default theme with custom colors using OKLCH color space, custom fonts (Inter, Crimson Text, Lora), animations, and includes typography and container-queries plugins.
project_state.json: Project state tracking file documenting the Poetry Portal project with completed features (home page, detail page, admin form, visual theme) and pending backend requirements (data model, CRUD methods).
